Amptweaker browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal events 2014 NAMM 2014 Amptweaker BigRock Pro Published on January 16, 2014 Amptweaker boost / preamp distortion pedal NAMM 2014 NAMM 2014 NAMM 2014 Information Amptweaker Amptweaker Introduces Bigrock Pro Pedal After introducing its TightMetal Pro distortion pedal, Amptweaker received many requests for a rock version, which it delivers in the Amptweaker BigRock Pro Pedal. Unlike most distortion pedals, which have a single boost, the BigRock Pro includes two boost knobs, one before and one after the distortion. This makes it easy to boost the gain and volume for the perfect solo tone. Patching a favorite delay into the Boost Effects loop gives the user one-stomp control of rock rhythm and lead. Added switches on the BigRock Pro allow it to get tones from Amptweaker's popular TightRock pedal, as well as its FatRock distortion pedals. These include the Smooth Edge switch, which cuts the high-end sizzle for a warmer edge, and two Fat switches that give either the normal or boosted tones a thicker attack with a bit more compression. The added three-band EQ allows for much tonal variation, with its PlexEQ button for a more traditional stack tone. Also included is Amptweaker's standard noise gate from the original TightRock , which tracks the gain knob and has internal adjustments. Amptweaker pedals are known for their effects loops, and this one has three: a universal loop, the Boost loop, and the popular SideTrak loop, which activates when the pedal is off, to automatically switch clean effects in and out. Standard Amptweaker features include LED illumination of controls, 918V operation, and true bypass switching. Amptweaker After introducing the popular TightMetal Pro™ distortion pedal in 2013, Amptweaker™ immediately received many requests for a two button Rock distortion.  With its included Fat and Smooth switches, the BigRock Pro™ can get all the familiar tones from our popular TightRock and FatRock pedals, and many more. Unlike most distortion pedals with boost, the BigRock Pro includes 2 Boost knobs, one before and one after the distortion.....so it's easy to boost the gain AND volume, for the perfect solo tone.
